topics.description: Multiple large-scale fraud schemes have been uncovered in Minnesota, including a $9B Somali fraud scheme and a $90M fraud scheme involving 15 accused individuals.
topics.reason: The scale and frequency of these fraud schemes are alarming and indicate a potential pattern of organized crime.

topics.description: A $21 million Medicaid fraud scheme involving two Minnesota residents has been uncovered, highlighting the need for increased scrutiny of healthcare programs.
topics.reason: The involvement of healthcare programs in fraud schemes can have serious consequences for vulnerable populations.
